paper_title: Room temperature Fe(NO3)3·9H2O/TEMPO/NaCl-catalyzed aerobic oxidation of homopropargylic alcohols

questions.question: In this paper, what does the abbreviation 'TEMPO' refer to?
What IUPAC name does the paper give for compound 3a?
Under the paper's standard conditions for the aerobic oxidation of 1-phenylbut-3-yn-1-ol (1a) to give 2a, what solvent, atmosphere, temperature and reaction time were used?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Solvent: DCE (1,2-dichloroethane); Atmosphere: O2 (balloon); Temperature: room temperature (rt); Time: 4 h

questions.question: Which gave the higher yield in the paper: oxidation of 1-(4-isopropylphenyl)but-3-yn-1-ol (1b) to 3b, or oxidation of 1-(4-methoxyphenyl)but-3-yn-1-ol (1d) to 3d?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Oxidation of 1b → 3b gave 91%, whereas 1d → 3d gave 81%; 1b → 3b is higher (91% vs 81%)

questions.question: What melting point and isolated yield does the paper report for 1-(4-methoxyphenyl)buta-2,3-dien-1-one (3d)?
